observations.behavior: Replaces all occurrences of the string literal 'MATERIALIZED' with 'DEFAULT' in ClickHouse column definitions, and renames the associated variable and function parameters from 'materialized_columns' to 'typed_columns'.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the storage behavior of the `flag_evaluations` table. Previously, columns were marked as MATERIALIZED, meaning ClickHouse would compute the value only when queried. This change switches them to DEFAULT, meaning ClickHouse will compute the value at insert time if the column is omitted, and allow updates to the column. This supports the ingestion path where properties are set
